verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the whole story. Editor plugins can be written entirely in GDScript without reloading the editor, and EditorScript's _run() executes custom in-editor scripts. Import plugins let custom resources be treated as first-class, and EditorInterface lets code save and reload scenes and inspect or edit resources programmatically. The Asset Library's Tools category and headless editor automation for CI add ecosystem and automation support. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of plugin and editor-script workflows.
